sig: [[["B", "Good afternoon, Rosa's Kitchen. How can I help you?"], ["A", "Hi, I'd like to book a table for a client dinner this Thursday, please."], ["B", "Of course. For how many people?"], ["A", "Six. Around seven o'clock, if possible."], ["B", "Let me see. Seven is fully booked, but I can offer you seven thirty."], ["A", "Seven thirty is fine. Do you have a private room? We'll be talking business."], ["B", "Yes, we do. There's a small room upstairs that seats eight. There's a fifty-dollar booking fee for it, though."], ["A", "That's OK. Oh, and one of our guests is vegetarian."], ["B", "No problem. Our chef has a full vegetarian menu. Could I have a name and phone number for the booking?"], ["A", "Sure. It's Ben Carter, from Atlas Software. My number is 555-0142."], ["B", "Thank you, Mr. Carter. I'll send you a confirmation text shortly."]], {"A": "M-AU", "B": "F-GB"}]
